evidence.excerpt: The complete current menu publishes dinner starters, salads, customizable and favorite pizzas, pastas, desserts, weekend brunch pizzas, and nonalcoholic soft drinks. Alcohol-only cocktail and wine sections were excluded.
The restaurant-linked store binds to 5037 Connecticut Avenue NW and exposes current featured/favorite pizzas, starters, salads, pastas, online beverages, and desserts; Beer is out of POC scope.
The official single-location site identifies Comet Ping Pong at 5037 Connecticut Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20008, with phone (202) 364-0404 and links its menu and exact Toast store.
